lensFocus.spec: This branch implements docs/plans/2026-11-03-hook-and-hygiene.md for issues .scratch/vecnet/issues/27-claude-code-hook.md and 29-screen-script-demo-leak.md, plus the short test heartbeat and the md-thread flake. Check restart replay is kept, dedupe by delivery id, first-run summary, oldest_cursor on 409, rememberEvents, settings.local.json default with order-preserving merge, statePath keying, reaper roots.
lensFocus.security: Peer text in hook output must be inert: cannot close or forge the <vecnet-inbox untrusted="true"> wrapper (including confusable brackets), no newlines/bidi/control chars, caps enforced. The hook can never block or fail a turn (exit codes, timeouts, lock contention). The reaper and group kills cannot hit unrelated processes or dirs. hook install never writes global or shared settings unless given an explicit --settings path.
lensFocus.tests: Check screen scripts wait on state, honour SHOTS_DIR, never bind 45752 or 49575; tests never touch real ~/.config/vecnet; each named plan test exists and fails without its fix; guard tests are marked; the heartbeat env var is set only by the screen scripts.
